fields.label: Hold Length (days)
fields.description: How long a tentative hold keeps the fountains before it lapses.

fields.label: Remind Before (days)
fields.description: The person who placed the hold gets a to-do this many days before it lapses. 0 turns the reminder off.

fields.label: Release Lapsed Holds Automatically
fields.description: Every morning, holds past their date are marked Expired and their fountains freed.

fields.label: Email the Customer When a Hold Is Placed
fields.description: Tells the booking's contact which fountains are held and until when.

fields.label: Enable /rent-a-fountain
fields.description: A public form that turns a rental enquiry into an Events Lead. It never shows availability. Uses the site's Turnstile keys from ERPNext Enhancements Settings (the same ones as /fountain-move).

fields.label: Invoicing
fields.description: Invoices are created as drafts. Nothing posts to the books until someone presses Submit & Send.

fields.label: Rental Item
fields.description: The invoice line for fountain and accessory rental charges.

fields.label: Delivery & Fees Item
fields.description: The invoice line for delivery, pickup and other fees. Blank uses the Rental Item.

fields.label: Sales Taxes Template
fields.description: Blank means rental invoices carry no tax until the Utah rental tax decision (OD-2) is made.

fields.label: Deposit (% of rental total)
fields.description: Drafted when the agreement is signed (or the booking is confirmed).

fields.label: Balance Invoice Before Delivery (days)
fields.description: The balance invoice is drafted this many days before delivery, due on the delivery date.

fields.label: Security Deposit Item
fields.description: A non-stock item for the refundable deposit line on the balance invoice. If you set a Sales Taxes Template, give this item a 0% Item Tax Template, or the deposit is taxed.

fields.label: Security Deposit Account
fields.description: A liability account. The deposit line posts here instead of to income, because it is owed back.
